主要内容: The document is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, published on February 24, 2016. It includes the First Quarter 2016 Earnings Release, a Report to Shareholders with management's discussion and analysis, and unaudited interim condensed consolidated financial statements. The filing is incorporated by reference into several Registration Statements on Form F-3 and S-8. The report is signed by Janice R. Fukakusa, Chief Administrative Officer and Chief Financial Officer of Royal Bank of Canada.
